name: CreateInstance

parameters.help_en: The name of the workspace. The name must start with a lowercase letter, can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-), and cannot end with a hyphen
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间名称。以小写英文字母开头，包含小写字母、数字、中划线，且不能用中划线结尾
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

- POST: pay-as-you-go

- PRE: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型，取值如下：
- POST：按量付费
- PRE：包年包月
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en: The region
parameters.help_zh: 地域
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)
parameters.help_zh: 专有网络VPC ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the vSwitches
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟交换机ID组
parameters.name: vswitchids

fields.help_en:
The number of CPUs.

> - The number of CPUs for the project must be less than the number of available CPUs in the workspace. The number of available CPUs is the total number of purchased CPUs minus the number of CPUs that are allocated to other projects. Otherwise, an error occurs
fields.help_zh:
CPU数量。
> - 在包年包月的工作空间下，CPU数量必填。在按量付费的工作空间下，可以不用填写CPU数量。- 创建的目标项目空间的CPU数量要小于工作空间中剩余CPU数量（工作空间购买的总CPU数量减去其他项目空间已分配CPU数量），否则会报错
fields.name: cpu

fields.help_en:
The memory size in GB.

> The memory size must be four times the number of CPUs
fields.help_zh:
内存大小。单位为GB。

> 内存大小必须为CPU数量的4倍
fields.name: memory_gb

parameters.help_en:
The resource specifications.

> This parameter is required when you set ChargeType to PRE
parameters.help_zh:
资源规格。

> 当ChargeType配置为PRE时，资源规格参数必填
parameters.name: resource_spec

parameters.help_en:
The billing cycle of the subscription instance. Valid values:

- **year**

- **month**

> This parameter is required if you set ChargeType to PRE
parameters.help_zh:
指定预付费实例为包年或包月类型，取值范围如下：

- **year**：年
- **month**：月

> 若付费类型为PrePaid，该参数为必传参数
parameters.name: pricing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration.

> This parameter is required when you set ChargeType to PRE
parameters.help_zh:
订购周期数量。

> 当ChargeType配置为PRE时，Duration参数必填
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

- **true**: Auto-renewal is enabled.

- **false**: Auto-renewal is disabled. This is the default value.

> This parameter does not take effect for pay-as-you-go instances
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动续费。取值：

- **true**：自动续费
- **false**：不自动续费（默认）

>按量付费时，该参数无效
parameters.name: auto_renew

fields.help_en: The name of the OSS bucket to attach
fields.name: bucket

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use fully managed storage. You can use either fully managed storage or an OSS bucket.

- true: Use fully managed storage.

- false: Do not use fully managed storage
fields.help_zh:
是否选择全托管存储，全托管存储和绑定oss bucket的方式仅能选择一种。
- true：使用。
- false：不使用
fields.name: fully_managed

parameters.help_en: The storage parameters
parameters.help_zh: 存储参数
parameters.name: storage

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a coupon. Valid values:

- true: Use a coupon.

- false: Do not use a coupon
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用优惠券。取值如下：
- true：使用。
- false：不使用
parameters.name: use_promotion_code

parameters.help_en: The coupon code
parameters.help_zh: 优惠券code
parameters.name: promotion_code

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The extended field
parameters.help_zh: 扩展字段
parameters.name: extra

parameters.help_en: The processor architecture
parameters.help_zh: 处理器架构
parameters.name: architecture_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable high availability (HA) within the same city
parameters.help_zh: 是否选择同城高可用资源
parameters.name: ha

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch IDs for the secondary zone of the HA configuration
parameters.help_zh: 同城高可用备可用区vswitch组
parameters.name: ha_vswitchids

fields.help_en: The number of CPUs for the HA configuration
fields.name: cpu

fields.help_en: The memory size for the HA configuration
fields.name: memory_gb

parameters.help_en: The resource specifications for the HA configuration
parameters.help_zh: 同城高可用资源描述
parameters.name: ha_resource_spec

parameters.help_en: The type of the alert service. You can select ARMS or Cloud Monitor
parameters.help_zh: 监控报警服务类型，可以选择arms或云监控
parameters.name: monitor_type

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. You can add up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
parameters.name: tag
